title: EC Public Key (P-256, compressed SEC1)
description: An NIST P-256 (secp256r1) public key in compressed SEC1 point form (33 bytes: a 0x02 or 0x03 prefix byte followed by the 32-byte big-endian X coordinate), Base64-encoded. Used on the BLE wire for the per-handshake ephemeral keys (Hello.appEphemeralPubKey, Challenge.stationEphemeralPubKey), the StationIdentity certificate's static key (stationPubKey), and the OfflinePass's device key (devicePublicKey, spec/profiles/offline/offline-pass.md 2), which travels inside the pass on BLE and MQTT alike. 33 bytes Base64-encode to exactly 44 characters with no padding. Encoding pin: compressed SEC1 (06-security.md §6.5.2) — NOT the 65-byte uncompressed form. A server signing key is not of this type at all: it travels as a DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo, never as a bare SEC1 point (06-security.md §6.7).
